source_refs: docs/decide/requirements/REQ-SAG-0501.md (MUST: decide MUST be able to send any request the TypeSafe API accepts)
findings.issue: a-10 builds every request with DecisionRequest::from(SystemOneRequest), so image_parts is empty and long_context is false. Neither the CLI nor the Python API can supply multipart image bytes or the TypeSafe-Danger-Zone-Long-Context header. Any example with Asset.part therefore fails DecisionRequest::validate (a part with no ImagePart). a-10 test 3 and its AC 'each TypeSafe request example can be sent' cannot hold for those examples.
findings.required_correction: Add a documented way to supply image parts (for example a --image NAME=FILE flag and a Python images argument) and long_context (--long-context / argument) to send and send_batch, including per-line batch input. Add a test that sends each openapi.json example that uses assets.part or long context through the real runner, and list it in the a-10 acceptance.

findings.issue: a-1, a-4 and a-5 defer to a-10 the end-to-end closure of REQ-SAG-0101 (decide --model short name through the catalog), REQ-SAG-0102 (a model added to ~/.sc-agent/default.json is resolved by decide) and REQ-SAG-0602 (decide reports http.quota_exhausted). a-10's requirements list names none of the three and a-10 has no acceptance line or test for any of them. The deferrals have no owner.
findings.required_correction: Add REQ-SAG-0101, 0102 and 0602 to a-10's requirements list. Add acceptance criteria and named tests: (1) decide send --model haiku resolves through the config-built catalog, with a default.json model dated later winning; (2) a 429 with the Anthropic quota body ends decide with http.quota_exhausted after one send. Otherwise remove the deferral from a-1/a-4/a-5 and prove them where they are.

findings.required_correction: Add an AC to a-10 (the last sprint, workspace complete) with a command such as rg -n 'Uuid|uuid::|uuid =' crates/ that finds no hit, or that lists exactly the external-API call sites. Name it in plan.md as the REQ-SAG-0001 AC2 owner.

source_refs: docs/requirements/REQ-SAG-0007.md (AC1: 0.123456789 returned unchanged by the Rust API, the CLI and the PyO3 bindings; AC2: workspace search finds no rounding)
findings.issue: Rounding is checked by test only in sc-decision-schema (a-2), sc-decision-llm (a-7) and the CLI (a-10 test 7). The PyO3 half has no test: the three sc-agent-py tests cover only the function list, cancel and the slug. The AC2 rg is limited to crates/sc-decision-schema and is not a workspace search.
findings.required_correction: Add a sc-agent-py pytest, or a Rust test of the string path sc-agent-py returns, that shows 0.123456789 unchanged through the Python result. Add a workspace-wide rg for round( / format precision on returned values to a-10's acceptance.

findings.required_correction: Add the missing ids to each sprint's yaml requirements list and add an acceptance line for each id that carries a deliverable (a-6 and a-7 REQ-SAG-0008 can cite their existing ANC-007 ACs).

source_refs: docs/sc-decision-local/requirements/REQ-SAG-0801.md (AC1: a runner added to the global configuration is selected by its name with no rebuild)
findings.issue: a-10 test 12 runs LocalBackend batches but never selects a runner by its default.json name. SendOptions, ModelsOptions and DoctorOptions have no config-directory or environment seam; the config always loads from default_dir() (home directory). Tests 14 (default log files), 16 (SC_AGENT__MAX_SENDS=2) and the REQ-SAG-0801 AC1 check depend on that seam. a-4 forbids mutating the process env in tests, but a-10 does not say how its tests redirect HOME or the SC_AGENT__ variables.
findings.required_correction: Add config_dir and environment (or a loaded AgentConfig) fields to SendOptions/ModelsOptions/DoctorOptions, or state the HOME/env mechanism. Add a named test that puts a local_runners entry in a tempdir default.json and sends --model <name> through it, citing REQ-SAG-0801 AC1.

gate_reason: FAIL. Seven Blocking findings: (1) a-10 cannot send multipart image parts or the long-context header, so REQ-SAG-0501 'any request' is unmet; (2) a-1/a-4/a-5 defer REQ-SAG-0101/0102/0602 end to end to a-10, which has no id, criterion or test for them; (3) REQ-SAG-0001 AC2 (UUID search) has no owner; (4) REQ-SAG-0007 has no PyO3 test and no workspace-wide search; (5) REQ-SAG-0004 AC3 (CLI vs PyO3 rows) is not proven; (6) sprint requirements lists are incomplete for a-2, a-6, a-7, a-9 and a-10; (7) REQ-SAG-0104 AC1 is claimed by a-1 with a same-crate test only. Cross-document conflicts remain: the locked ADR-SAG-0004 anchor against a-10 (REQ-QA-011), a-9 against a-5 on PLAN-CRIT-003 (REQ-QA-012), a-8 against a-10 on Python logger injection (REQ-QA-013), and the plan dependency tables (REQ-QA-014). Coverage of the records: 26 of 33 applicable records (78.8%) and 63 of 71 record acceptance criteria (88.7%) are owned by a testable sprint criterion; the 7 incomplete records are REQ-SAG-0001, 0004, 0007, 0104, 0302, 0501 and 0801. ADR-SAG-0003 is process-only. Sprint-level acceptance criteria are otherwise concrete and testable, and every sprint has a requirements list, a copy-first criterion, cargo tree/sleep checks and named tests. The review is docs-only at commit 2e0fed6 (HEAD is refs/heads/main = 2e0fed61292d7f964b763aae79b50a07af1cb0aa). No code was run or checked. The records are all Draft; I treated them as binding because the assignment names them as the plan's records.
